prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 film-noir portrait of an original adult woman with short wavy dark hair, natural skin texture, and a composed upward gaze. She wears a black high-neck sleeveless evening dress with subtle ribbed texture and unbranded drop earrings. Pose her in a three-quarter waist-up profile against a pure black minimal setting. Use one harsh spotlight from above-left tinted acidic green with a faint muted amber edge, revealing only part of her face and shoulders. Preserve deep black negative space, crisp shadow edges, realistic pores, subtle analog grain, and no text or logos.
